name: remote-approval-complexity
goal: Remote approval validation meets the existing complexity limit while preserving exact projects and optional comment permissions.

evidence: Approved behavior-preserving Remote cleanup is documented in the model-list feature spec. The normal Remote lint currently reports approval complexity 13 against the unchanged limit 10.

Existing control-input cases lacked the full optional comment matrix and exact output shape, and 65 duplicate IDs did not isolate the count ceiling. Strengthened the standard cases with omitted/invalid comments and 64/65 distinct projects; all behavior must remain identical.

Test-only commit 6c9bccb58b4d482e3993d9e2971df7bc189fc42a produced immutable red record 492a14014c14eceecd60f72210326c9fd36fd820b12ceaf771540e4567035925. Normal lint rejects approval complexity 13 against limit 10; all four strengthened runtime cases pass. No product source is repaired yet.
